pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark regions exhibit star-like polygonal geometries with jagged, high-frequency edge angularity. Edge gradients are sharp, with patches on the central flank being larger and more regular than those on the neck region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways with frequent tri-axial junction nodes. The pixel thickness of the corridors is narrow and relatively uniform across the central flank area.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jaggedness along the mane line; the profile is fuzzy due to resolution but maintains a consistent 1D geometric frequency against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small avian organism (likely an oxpecker) on the mid-dorsal flank region.
